method: Exclusive userspace instruction-pointer sampling at 500 Hz; average CPU milliseconds per transition, reader UI plus dedicated chapter worker only. Zero means no samples attributed to that symbol.
comparability: Same chapter boundary and book. Earlier function capture was a different build, landscape, and different reader settings, so numerical differences do not isolate the optimization effects.

functions.function: <alloc::rc::Rc<dyn for<'a, 'b> core::ops::function::Fn<(gpui::geometry::Bounds<gpui::geometry::Pixels>, &'a mut gpui::window::Window, &'b mut gpui::app::App), Output = bool>>>::drop_slow

assembly_symbol_resolution.method: Exported assembly entrypoints have STT_NOTYPE and zero sizes; infer ranges up to the next known memory-routine entrypoint or executable section end. Original unresolved symbols remain in functions and sampled_symbols for audit.
